item.title: Double yellow lines might help with parking on junction, 14th October
item.description:
Cars are parking on the junction between 40 and 42 Greenways, under the cherry tree, causing obstruction to motorists and sometimes parking over my driveway. This causes visibility issues for drivers and for me exiting my driveway. I believe the Highway Code prohibits parking at junctions and I think a simple solution would be the provision of a small stretch of double yellow lines (like the ones nearby outside 28 Uplands ) . These would stop obstructions at this junction. Thank you for your attention to this matter .

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Greenways, Beckenham, Greater London
